description: This file defines a NestJS controller for managing organization team memberships, including endpoints for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting memberships within a specific organization and team.

classes.name: OrganizationsTeamsMembershipsController
classes.description: NestJS controller handling organization team membership operations such as listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting memberships within specified organization and team contexts.

methods.name: getAllOrgTeamMemberships
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all memberships for a specific organization and team, with pagination support.

methods.name: getOrgTeamMembership
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of a specific membership by ID.

methods.name: deleteOrgTeamMembership
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a specific membership.

methods.name: updateOrgTeamMembership
methods.description: Handles PATCH requests to update details of a specific membership, including logic to trigger event type updates if membership acceptance status changes.

methods.name: createOrgTeamMembership
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new membership, with logic to auto-accept based on organization policies and to update event types if accepted.

search-terms: API endpoints for organization team memberships
